subject: Updating build script and github workflow to get test framework from github and removing it locally (#56)
reason: The change modifies only build/CI/test infrastructure: ci.yml and build.sh now clone the valkey-test-framework repo from GitHub, the vendored copy under tests/valkeytests/ is deleted, .gitignore gains an entry, and one test file loses a trailing newline. No module source code (src/) is touched, so the compiled valkey-bloom module and all its runtime behaviour (commands, replies, persistence) are identical on both builds; there is nothing a scenario could reach or differentiate.
